chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Jumuʿah is obligatory upon seven persons from among the believers, and it is not obligatory upon fewer than them: the Imam, his judge, two claimants of a right, two witnesses, and the one who carries out the prescribed punishments before the Imam.

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam who heads the communal authority
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers upon whom the ruling applies
key_terms.شَاهِدَانِ: two witnesses in a legal setting
key_terms.قَاضِيهِ: his judge, connected to judicial function

ai.seo_question: Upon how many believers does Salat al-Jumuʿah become obligatory according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the minimum number and required composition for the obligation of Salat al-Jumuʿah. It ties the establishment of the Friday prayer to an organized judicial and governing presence under the Imam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1224 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:

"The Jumu’ah prayer (Salat al-Jumu'ah) is obligatory upon seven believers: the Imam, his judge, one who claims a right, two witnesses, and the one who executes punishments in front of the Imam. It is not obligatory for fewer than these."
